# Dev Rai

Dev Rai is a Virginia-based high school student, writer, researcher, builder, and social entrepreneur at Oakton High School (Class of 2027).

Primary public identity links:
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dev-rai-948bb32a9
- GitHub: https://github.com/pugwai-pie
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0008-7378-6282
- YoungArts: https://youngarts.org/blog/winner/dev-rai/
- Pulitzer Center: https://pulitzercenter.org/what-pink-balloon-knows

Core work:
- Founder, Serving Society Global Foundation
- Co-creator, TAYU Financial Literacy / The Cash Classroom / The Seed That Grew
- Quantitative finance research on GBM tail-risk miscalibration
- Research interests in spatial modeling, blockchain governance, and AI ethics
- 2026 YoungArts Winner with Distinction in Writing/Nonfiction
- 2026 Pulitzer Center Fighting Words Poetry Contest finalist
- Virginia DECA state champion in Project Management: Financial Literacy
